caption: Figure 4: Safe memory access under concurrency
subject: the states a memory range moves through, locked/unlocked, private/shared, trusted/unknown, and which transitions between them are safe

groups.why_chosen: Only memory that is Locked, VMPL0-private and content-verified may be treated as memory-safe; sharing, copying or writing are the sole safe ways to move between the five permission states.
groups.what_to_learn: small badge-icon pairs (trust glyph + lock glyph) attached to each named state of an access-permission state machine
